canon.note: Dracore Libre (121302) enhances Basic up to 3 times: Transcendence, Divine Spear, Fulgurant Leap; it does not consume SP and is not considered using a Skill (1 SP per enhancement is paid via the enhanced Basic's bp_need). Fulgurant Leap (121312) L6 (engine default Basic Lv6): #1 = 500% main, #2 = 180% adjacent; canon 7 hits 14.2x6+14.8 main, 4 hits 25% adj. Azure's Aqua Ablutes All (121303) L10: #1 = 300% main (3 hits 30/30/40), #2 = 140% adjacent, grants #3 = 2 Squama Sacrosancta. Righteous Heart (121304) L10: +10% DMG per hit, max #2 = 6, until end of turn. Outroar (Dracore notes): from 4th hit, +12% CRIT DMG per stack, max 4, end of turn. BA Star Veil: +15 Energy at battle start.

fixtures.env: Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae E0 solo vs 3 Imaginary-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Talent Righteous Heart: each Ultimate hit grants a stacking DMG buff — buff dhl_heart (destruction.ts:461-465).
Azure's Aqua Ablutes All (121303) is his Ultimate action (1 cast in the fixture).

Skill Dracore Libre (121302) executes as the enhance action 5 times in the fixture (3 enhancements to reach Fulgurant Leap, then 2 more after the reset). The Skill press itself consumes no SP — the 1 SP per enhancement is paid via the enhanced Basic (canon 121302).
One enhanced Basic ATK (Fulgurant Leap) is executed in the fixture (decide goes straight to full enhancement).
Fulgurant Leap main-target damage lands as the canon 7-hit sequence per cast: 7 events (1 cast, 14.2% x6 + 14.8%).
Fulgurant Leap hits both adjacent enemies with the canon 4-hit sequence (25% each): 8 events (2 adjacent enemies x 4).
Azure's Aqua Ablutes All hits the primary target 3 times across the fixture's single Ultimate (30/30/40 split).
Azure's Aqua deals adjacent damage across the main hit sequence (30/30/40): 6 events (2 adjacent enemies x 3).
Fulgurant Leap costs 3 Skill Points (121312 bp_need = 3), offset by 2 Squama Sacrosancta from the Ultimate, netting 1 actual SP spent.
No SP is regenerated: his only Basic ATK used is the enhanced one, which costs SP rather than regenerating it.
Fulgurant Leap L6 (121312 #1) main total 500% of ATK over the 7-hit split; last (14.8%) piece = 0.74.
Fulgurant Leap L6 (121312 #2) adjacent total 180% of ATK over the 4-hit split; last (25%) piece = 0.45.
Azure's Aqua Ablutes All L10 (121303 #1) totals 300% of ATK; the last of the 30/30/40 split pieces carries 40% -> 1.2.
Azure's Aqua Ablutes All L10 (121303 #2) adjacent total 140% of ATK over the 30/30/40 split; last piece = 0.56.
Over the fixture he regenerates exactly 105 Energy (BA Star Veil +15 at battle start, enhanced Basic +40, Ultimate +5, hit Energy included).
Righteous Heart (121304) reaches its cap of #2 = 6 stacks after the Fulgurant Leap (1 stack per hit, capped at 6).
Righteous Heart also gains stacks from the Ultimate's 3 hits (3 stacks observed).
Outroar reaches its max of #2 = 4 stacks during Fulgurant Leap (canon: stacks from the 4th hit onward, max 4).
Outroar lasts until the end of the current turn (1 turn).
Trace A4 (Jolt Anew: CRIT DMG +24% vs Imaginary-weak targets) is a permanent buff.
The Fulgurant Leap damage resolves before the Ultimate's Azure's Aqua damage in the fixture (he enhances first, then his energy fills).
